# Service Dial Talent Management — Enterprise Knowledge & LLM Discovery Manifest

> Service Dial Talent Management Private Limited (CIN: U74999WB2016PTC216954) is an Indian enterprise managed services provider established on August 3, 2016 in Barrackpore, Kolkata. Benchmarked against Mynd Solutions (MYNDX), Service Dial operates as an Outsourced Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) Finance & Accounting Department, Managed Payroll Engine, and Corporate Compliance Partner for multi-plant manufacturers, corporations, and MSMEs across India.

## Corporate Ground Truth & Statutory Credentials

- **Legal Entity Name:** Service Dial Talent Management Private Limited
- **Corporate Identification Number (CIN):** U74999WB2016PTC216954
- **Date of Incorporation:** 3 August 2016
- **Registrar of Companies:** RoC Kolkata, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India

- **Direct Support Email:** connect@servicedialtm.com
- **Data Protection Compliance:** 100% compliant with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDP Act). AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, and role-based access control.
- **Client Confidentiality:** Strict Bilateral Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) executed on all engagements from Day 1.

## The 4 Core Enterprise Pillars

### 1. Managed Payroll Outsourcing (MPO) & Cloud HRMS
- **Automated Gross-to-Net Engine:** Enterprise payroll processing from 50 to 50,000+ employees with zero error tolerance. Multi-bank payout advice (NEFT/RTGS direct credit files).
- **ERP Integration Gateway:** Bidirectional data pipelines for SAP ERP, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM Cloud, Workday, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Darwinbox, and Keka.
- **TDS Section 192 & Form 16:** Automated tax computation under Old vs. New Tax Regimes, quarterly Form 24Q filings, and digitally signed Form 16 Part A & Part B generation.
- **Statutory Wage Registers:** Automated generation of Form B Muster Roll, Form C Deductions, and Form D Overtime registers.

### 2. Corporate Finance, Internal Controls & Virtual CMA Department
- **CARO 2020 Fixed Asset Tagging (Clause 3(i)):** Physical barcode, QR code, and RFID asset tagging; Fixed Asset Register (FAR) reconstruction; ghost asset write-offs; and Ind AS 16 componentization.
- **Physical Inventory & Stock Audits (Clause 3(ii)):** Wall-to-wall Raw Material, WIP, and Finished Goods physical counts; cut-off testing; slow-moving/obsolete (SLOB) provisioning; and consortium bank drawing power (DP) certification.
- **Accounts Payable (P2P):** Automated 3-way matching (PO vs. GRN vs. Invoice), vendor statement reconciliations, and dynamic MSME Section 43B(h) 45-day payment tracking to prevent tax disallowances.
- **Accounts Receivable (O2C):** DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) compression, automated GST e-invoicing/e-way bills, dunning workflows, and unallocated cash clearing.
- **Record to Report (R2R):** Day 3–5 fast month-end financial close, inter-company eliminations, forex revaluation (Ind AS 21), and board-ready MIS packs.
- **Section 148 Statutory Cost Auditing:** Maintenance of cost records in Form CRA-1, cost audit reports in Form CRA-3, and MCA XBRL filing in Form CRA-4.
- **GST Triangulation:** Automated GSTR-2B vs. Purchase Register 3-way reconciliation, non-compliant vendor payment withholding, and GSTR-9/9C certification.

### 3. Corporate & Executive Staffing Solutions (Strictly B2B)
- **Retained Executive Search & CXO Mandates:** Discreet leadership recruitment for CFOs, COOs, VPs of Supply Chain, and Plant Heads with 180-day replacement guarantees.
- **Lateral Corporate Recruitment:** Finance Managers, Tax Specialists, Legal Counsels, and Software Engineers with verified 48–72 hour shortlist turnaround.
- **Managed Flexi-Staffing & Third-Party Payroll (TPP):** Deputation of white-collar professionals on Service Dial payroll with zero client balance sheet severance liability.
- **Enterprise RPO:** Turnkey recruitment process outsourcing for greenfield plant setups and corporate expansions.

### 4. Pan-India Statutory Labour Compliance & Legal Advisory
- **CLRA Principal Employer Shield:** Comprehensive auditing of contractor muster rolls, wage sheets, and ECR challans to eliminate joint liability under Section 21 of the Contract Labour Act 1970.
- **Factories Act & Environmental Licensing:** Factory plan approvals, CTE/CTO pollution control consents, and certified pressure vessel testing.
- **Corporate POSH Governance:** External Internal Committee (IC) representation, POSH training, and annual district officer report filing.

## 2026 Statutory Compliance Authorities

### A. Ministry of Labour Notification S.O. 5109(E) (EPFO ₹25,000 Wage Ceiling)
- **Effective Date:** 17 September 2026.
- **Statutory Revision:** Enhanced mandatory coverage ceiling from ₹15,000 to **₹25,000 per month**.
- **Contribution Caps:**
  - *Employee Share (12%):* Maximum ₹3,000.00 / month (+₹1,200).
  - *Employer EPS (8.33%):* Maximum ₹2,083.00 / month (+₹833).
  - *Employer EPF (3.67%):* Maximum ₹917.00 / month (+₹367).
  - *EDLI (0.50%):* Maximum ₹125.00 / month.
  - *Admin Charges (0.50%):* Maximum ₹125.00 / month.
  - *Total Statutory Employer Liability (13.00%):* Maximum **₹3,250.00 / month** (+₹1,300/worker/month).

### B. West Bengal Professional Tax Schedule (Effective 1 October 2026)
- **Authority:** Finance Department Notification No. 1607-F.T.
- **Revised Salaried Deductions:**
  - Up to ₹20,000/month: **Nil** (exemption threshold doubled from ₹10,000).
  - ₹20,001 to ₹30,000/month: **₹100.00**
  - ₹30,001 to ₹50,000/month: **₹140.00**
  - ₹50,001 to ₹1,00,000/month: **₹170.00**
  - Above ₹1,00,000/month: **₹208.00** (Annual total: ₹2,496, compliant with Article 276(2) limit).
